svg.title: Removing both elements requires restoring the intended orientation
svg.desc: Three starting poses in the same Z-up scene and camera. Left: keep the base and fixed joint. Middle: remove both and use the body as root without replacing the stored rotation; the cabinet starts sideways. Right: also remove both, then rotate the whole model in the scene by the original fixed-joint rotation; the cabinet starts upright. These are starting orientations, not a physics simulation.
